caption:
NOMNI TECHNICAL PAPER — PART I

The NOMNI issuer framework describes a Bitcoin-native monetary architecture using Bitcoin as the settlement base and Counterparty as the asset protocol. Above that technical base, NOMNI defines issuer-designed monetary, treasury, and Ausarian Economics policy components.

This distinction matters: Bitcoin and Counterparty protocol behavior can be independently verified; NOMNI-specific treasury policy, reserve design, monetary doctrine, asset identifiers, and valuation methodology must be documented and verified separately.

Architecture: Bitcoin settlement base → Counterparty asset protocol → NOMNI issuer framework.

Market values are intentionally excluded from this campaign until a timestamped source and methodology record is attached.
